args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent healthy production release (the `v2.3.1-rc` entry was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was skipped).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0002` describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent healthy production release (the `v2.3.1-rc` entry was staging-only and unhealthy, so it was skipped).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0002` describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.
